1. **Choose Language**: Option to select the language for the app.
2. **Enable LED**: Checkbox to enable or disable the LED notification.
3. **Enable Leash**: Checkbox to enable or disable the leash feature.
4. **Choose Date Format**: Option to select the preferred date format.
5. **Choose Time Format**: Option to select the preferred time format.
6. **Choose Scroll Speed**: Option to set the speed at which text scrolls, currently set to 1.
7. **Choose Alert Scroll Delay**: Option to set the delay for alert scrolling, currently set to 5 seconds.
